show.description: When a fire traps 11-year-old Jiya inside her burning mansion, firefighter Vikram rushes to save her. But a minor road accident with billionaire couple Mihir and Sanya turns into a nightmare as they humiliate, assault, and blackmail him for money, delaying his rescue. Unaware that the child fighting for life is their own daughter, they let ego overpower humanity in a race against time.
